scope: Policy engine for Fortnite season/pass/ranked lifecycle, calendar projection and transition linking

principles.facts_vs_policy: The lifecycle ledger stores observed facts/state; this engine defines inference, projection, reminder and linking rules.
principles.parallel_clocks: Battle Royale, OG, Festival, LEGO, collab/minipass and Ranked clocks run independently unless an official relation joins them.
principles.no_boundary_inference: END_AT on one track never becomes START_AT on another track by arithmetic or adjacency.
principles.no_ui_timer_inference: Client/UI timers are not authoritative unless captured through an official authorized source policy.
principles.stable_calendar: Lifecycle enrichment preserves existing calendar UIDs; separate logical milestones get separate UIDs only when independently actionable.
principles.quiet_calendar: Store more lifecycle facts than are projected into Apple Calendar.

field_rules.season_identity: Requires Fortnite News/Battle Pass explicit season/chapter identity.
field_rules.pass_identity: Requires official pass/product/news naming; do not create from cosmetic bundles alone.
field_rules.start_at: Requires official date/time or explicit availability window. Announcement publication time is not start time.
field_rules.end_at: Requires official end date/time. A date-only source remains DATE_ONLY.
field_rules.last_earn_at: Separate from pass end and only stored when Epic explicitly distinguishes last time to earn progression/rewards.
field_rules.last_claim_at: Separate from last earn/end; never assume unclaimed rewards disappear at END_AT without official evidence.
field_rules.rank_reset_at: Requires explicit Ranked reset statement/date. Season launch alone cannot create it.
field_rules.next_start_at: Requires direct official next-track launch date/time or an explicitly linked service transition window.
field_rules.downtime_relation: Epic Status confirms downtime timing; Fortnite content source must establish lifecycle relation unless Epic itself states it explicitly.

rules: PASS_FOR_SEASON does not imply identical start/end timestamps.
RANKED_FOR_SEASON does not imply a reset at season start/end.
NEXT_TRACK may exist with unknown NEXT_START_AT.
TRANSITION_DOWNTIME requires an official service_event_id and explicit lifecycle relation.
REPLACED_BY means the successor is actually active/officially replacing the prior track, not merely announced.

calendar_projection.date_only: DATE_ONLY pass/season end may be all-day only if the source truly expresses a calendar date; description must say exact hour is unpublished.
calendar_projection.exact: EXACT milestones use timezone-aware DTSTART and appropriate reminder profile.
calendar_projection.window_only: WINDOW_ONLY stays ledger/watchlist unless the window itself is the official event period and useful to plan.
calendar_projection.grouping: Related end/downtime/start milestones share calendar_group_id/RELATED-TO where useful but remain distinct logical events.
calendar_projection.anti_duplicate: A successor launch already represented by a season event is never duplicated as a pass event unless the pass starts at a materially different time/action.

reminder_policy.extension: When END_AT moves later, increment lifecycle_version, invalidate old future notices and recalculate without creating a new UID.
reminder_policy.shortening: When END_AT moves earlier officially, replace future notices immediately and notify only if materially actionable.

ranked_policy.tracks: Ranked Battle Royale/Zero Build/Reload may be separate ranked_scope values if Epic publishes separate cycles.
ranked_policy.no_mode_spread: A reset stated for one mode does not automatically apply to other Ranked modes.
ranked_policy.competitive_calendar_guard: Ranked reset can appear in updates/global; ordinary Ranked cups remain governed by the competitive ledger.

pass_policy.reward_claim_guard: Do not infer LAST_CLAIM_AT from END_AT.
pass_policy.purchase_guard: Availability/purchase deadline and progression deadline may differ; store separately when official.
pass_policy.replacement_guard: A new pass does not automatically end the old pass unless the official lifecycle says so.

watchlist_bridge.rule: Use existing candidate queue for vague public announcements; use lifecycle watch_tracks for permanent category monitoring.
watchlist_bridge.promotion: When an exact/usable milestone appears, create/update the track first, then project to calendar if policy allows, then resolve/update the candidate.
watchlist_bridge.no_duplicate_watch: A category watch target does not require one candidate per day/recheck.

deadline_bridge.legacy: BATTLE_PASS_END_DATE remains accepted for existing Runners entry; future generic pass deadlines should use PASS_END_AT + pass_type.
deadline_bridge.calendar_deadline_sync: A lifecycle deadline and matching VEVENT must share track_id/milestone_id and source precision.

silent: successor relation with no actionable time

history_policy.anti_noise: checked_at/observed_at alone never append history or trigger a commit.
